strings.ui_help_close: Close this panel. Actions already accepted by the server remain applied.
strings.ui_help_refresh: Read the current page again from the server without running a management action.
strings.ui_help_previous: Read the previous page of this list.
strings.ui_help_next: Read the next page of this list.
strings.ui_help_identity_lists: Cycle the online-player, permitted-identity and admin lists. This changes the displayed list, not its membership.
strings.ui_help_delve_views: Cycle regeneration kinds, recent actions, due sites, nearest sites and nature status. Viewing a list does not regenerate anything.
strings.ui_help_moderation_views: Switch between recent audit entries and the moderation ledger. Viewing records does not moderate a player.
strings.ui_help_select: Select this entry for the actions below. Selection alone changes no player, list or world state.
strings.ui_help_tab_people: Inspect online players and native permitted/admin lists, then choose a player or identity action.
strings.ui_help_tab_moderation: Review the audit log and moderation ledger, including entries eligible for unbanning.
strings.ui_help_tab_messages: Manage broadcasts, the message of the day, recurring announcements and scheduled shutdowns.
strings.ui_help_tab_world: Inspect or change world utilities. Destructive resets use their existing preview or confirmation paths.
strings.ui_help_tab_regeneration: Inspect Delve regeneration status and request the supported regeneration actions.
strings.ui_help_kick: Open a reason prompt to disconnect the selected player. The server rechecks permission before applying it.
strings.ui_help_ban: Open a reason prompt to ban the selected player and disconnect them after confirmation.
strings.ui_help_tempban: Choose a ban duration and reason for the selected player, then confirm the temporary ban.
strings.ui_help_warn: Write a warning to the selected player through the moderation system.
strings.ui_help_mute: Choose how long to mute the selected player and provide a reason.
strings.ui_help_unmute: Request removal of the selected player's chat mute.
strings.ui_help_goto: Confirm travel to the selected player. Existing teleport permissions and checks still apply.
strings.ui_help_bring: Confirm bringing the selected player to you. Existing teleport permissions and checks still apply.
strings.ui_help_unban: Confirm removal of the selected ban entry from the moderation ledger.
strings.ui_help_permit: Add a platform identity to the native permitted-player list after review.
strings.ui_help_unpermit: Confirm removal of the selected platform identity from the permitted-player list.
strings.ui_help_admin_add: Add a platform identity to the native admin list when admin-list editing is allowed.
strings.ui_help_admin_remove: Confirm removal of the selected identity from the native admin list. Admin-list editing must be allowed.
strings.ui_help_broadcast: Compose a server broadcast and choose its message location before sending.
strings.ui_help_shutdown: Schedule a server shutdown after the entered number of minutes and confirmation.
strings.ui_help_save_world: Request a world save through the existing server command.
strings.ui_help_motd: Edit the current message of the day. An empty submitted message clears it after review.
strings.ui_help_announcements: Open the recurring-announcement editor to review messages and repeat intervals.
strings.ui_help_seed: Show this world's seed through the server command.
strings.ui_help_time: Choose the world clock time and optionally freeze time progression. Opening the editor changes nothing.
strings.ui_help_resume_time: Release the clock freeze and resume normal world-time progression.
strings.ui_help_ward_on: Request a ward-access override for your current character and session, subject to server rules. Ward ownership is unchanged.
strings.ui_help_ward_off: Release your character's ward-access override. Ward ownership is unchanged.
strings.ui_help_terrain: Preview a terrain reset within the entered radius, then review and confirm it. Destructive changes are not made by opening the editor.
strings.ui_help_drops: Preview eligible loose-item cleanup and confirm before removing the displayed drops.
strings.ui_help_add: Add a recurring announcement by entering its text and repeat interval.
strings.ui_help_edit: Edit the selected recurring announcement's text or repeat interval.
strings.ui_help_remove: Confirm removal of the selected recurring announcement.
